description: Hand-authored response-body fixtures for the market-data vendor adapters (src/quant_fund/data/vendors/). Each file reproduces the vendor's documented wire format byte-for-byte in shape; OHLCV values are SYNTHETIC (plausible scale, fabricated numbers) written by hand for contract tests and the reconciliation tool. They are NOT captured from live APIs and must not be cited as market evidence.
